title: Farmers and environmentalists protest Omnibus X pesticide reform in Strasbourg
seoTitle: Strasbourg protest against Omnibus X reform

tea.why: Protesters opposed the EU's Omnibus X proposal to ease pesticide regulations and remove periodic chemical safety renewals.
tea.want: They demanded that Members of the European Parliament reject the proposed Omnibus X legislative package.
tea.changed: Nov 24: Hundreds of protesters gathered outside the European Parliament in Strasbourg to oppose the Omnibus X proposal.

summary: On 24 November 2026, farmers, scientists, environmental campaigners, and health advocates gathered outside the European Parliament in Strasbourg. Backed by more than 300 environmental and agricultural organisations, including consumer group foodwatch, demonstrators protested against the European Commission's proposed Food and Feed Safety Omnibus package, known as Omnibus X. The proposed reform would end mandatory periodic re-evaluations for certain pesticide approvals. Demonstrators asked European lawmakers to vote down the text, arguing that weakening regulations threatens public health, water quality, and soil ecosystems. European Commission representatives and supporters stated that existing approval processes cause administrative delays and that the package would save significant funds for administrations and companies.
demands: Reject the Omnibus X legislative package
Maintain mandatory periodic renewals and safety reviews for pesticides
response: European Commission representatives and supporters argued that existing approval procedures are delayed by administrative burdens and that the reform would save over one billion euros annually for companies and national administrations.

crowd.text: organisers estimated 500 participants, while AFP reported around 350

updates.text: Demonstrators gathered outside the European Parliament in Strasbourg to demand the rejection of the Omnibus X pesticide reform package.
